## Problem

Predict the sale price of 21,613 houses sold in King County (Seattle area) between 2014 and 2015.

## Approach

Geographic analysis with GeoPandas and Folium, log transformation of the target and hyperparameter optimization with Ray Tune.

## Technologies

[Python]{.tag} [GeoPandas]{.tag} [Folium]{.tag} [Ray Tune]{.tag} [scikit-learn]{.tag}
